Clinical Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a collision that occurred while the patient's vehicle was turning left and was sturck
from the side. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury described, and the presenting
complaints align with this type of impact. Over the course of 22 visits, care included physical examination, a
structured rehabilitation program, and monitored range-of-motion exercises. Treatment progressed along a typical
clinical pathway, with visit frequency decreasing as pain and mobility improved and the patient was discharged to a
home exercise routine. Several examination findings, including limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff,
support the reported injury, while other orthopedic and neurological tests returned normal results. No prior injury to
